invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter instance; result cannot be null.
conf is passed to the constructor, and would throw a NullPointerException if null—method assumes non-null.
writeConfig is required for the construction of JavaHoodieBackedTableMetadataWriter and thus must be non-null.
context is directly passed to the constructor and assumed always non-null at method exit.
